Dear friends, 

New lessons of the course "25 holography lessons" have been published in "Technology" section of our web site. These are:

#19 - Latensification ( [http://www.holography.ru/les19eng.htm](http://www.holography.ru/les19eng.htm) )

#20 - Preparation of chemical solutions ( [http://www.holography.ru/les20eng.htm](http://www.holography.ru/les20eng.htm) )

#21 - Chemical processing of transmission holograms ( [http://www.holography.ru/les21eng.htm](http://www.holography.ru/les21eng.htm) )
